commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Difference in comprehension accuracy (percentage points) between the marked forms prob(E)=p / odds-for(E)=a:b / odds-against(E)=b:a and the complete careful-English statement of the same reported probability claim, on the source's three held-out probes (event probability share, complement share, equivalent odds-against orientation), over 72 wholly fresh items = the source's nine equal-weight settlement strata x 8, never pooled across strata for settlement; a fresh-input settlement replication of Dexagon's original 342303a33f… on a different two-lineage local reader class.
admissibility_gates: each reader alone clears the planted calibration control (absolute-gap-v1, min_gap 0.5) without retry selection
every real item is fresh for this principal: new events, model labels and numeric values; zero pair or arm overlap with the source kit
the nine settlement strata are the source's, equal weight, every one load-bearing; no pooled figure stands in for any
no reader cell is retried; a transport fault or bound truncation is a typed dead cell, and the yield guard decides whether the run may emit
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)

disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: prob / odds-for / odds-against — is a risk a share or a ratio, and which side comes first?

comparator.description: Identical contextual facts in both arms; direct complete English for the question asked. Scope and omitted dimensions are explicit in DESIGN.md.

manifest.settlement_rule: manifest-weighted arms and value; every stratum load-bearing
manifest.protocol: panel.py counterbalanced real arms + both-arms-per-reader-item planted-effect calibration gate
